description: My name is Aadhya and I'm interested in design, storytelling, and coming up with ideas.
summary:
Voices Across the Void: Stories of the Left Behind

Most spacecraft never come home. Voices Across the Void is an interactive, scroll-driven website about NASA machines that stayed out there, each telling its own story in the first person.

As visitors scroll, each machine narrates its journey in short sections over a cinematic background, with key facts beside the story such as launch dates and current status. An interactive timeline places four machines (the rover, Opportunity, Voyager 1 and Voyager 2) on one timeline. Each one’s line shows how long it kept working, and visitors can press play, drag through the years, or tap a marker to learn what happened. Hidden discovery points reward exploration:

why water ice survives in craters near the Moon’s poles that never see sunlight;
why sunsets on Mars glow blue;
a playable recording of real interstellar plasma waves that Voyager 1 measured, which NASA JPL turned into sound.

The goal is to give people an emotional connection to space exploration. Machines we leave behind are not just debris.
details:
Voices Across the Void is a scroll-driven story website. Three NASA machines that never came home tell their own stories in the first person

The site has:

An interactive timeline

Hidden discovery points

Accessibility and comfort

Copyright and credit

Keeping it simple

  • It makes space history easier to approach. Instead of reading a list of facts, visitors follow a story, so the facts are easier to remember.
  • It’s accurate and checkable. Every claim is based on NASA sources, many story sections link straight to their source with a “NASA ↗” link, and mission status shows the date it was last checked.
  • It’s easy to share and use. It’s a single file that runs in any modern browser on a phone, tablet or computer, with no app, account or installation.
  • It’s considerate of different visitors. A reduced-motion option respects people who are sensitive to animation, and the layout is designed for phones as well as desktops.
  • It’s honest about AI. Every AI-generated visual is labelled on screen as not real footage, so visitors are never misled.
